descriptions.notStarted: I gathered up all the materials that #p2060100# asked me get. Maybe I can now find out what happened to Gail.
descriptions.inProgress: According to #b#p2060100##k, something terrible indeed happened to Gail. What can possibly happen underwater? Anyway, I should let #b#p2060006##k of this immediately. I hope he takes it well...
descriptions.completed: I told #b#p2060006##k the result of #b#p2060100##k's fortune-telling. What does it mean by the dark fog that surrounds Gail? #p2060006# was trying to act calm, but I could tell she's feeling nervous about Gail. Is #p2060100#'s stuff really worth believing?
